description: This file defines the ClientResolver class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for resolving and validating configuration options for AWS service clients. It includes detailed methods for setting up credentials, endpoints, retries, signing, and other client settings, facilitating flexible client instantiation.

classes.name: Aws\ClientResolver
classes.description: Internal class responsible for resolving and validating configuration options for AWS clients, including credentials, endpoints, retry strategies, signing, and middleware setup.

methods.name: getDefaultArguments
methods.description: Returns an array of default client arguments with their configuration schema.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClientResolver with a given set of argument definitions.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and validates the client configuration options and attaches handlers, returning the final configuration array.

methods.name: getArgMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message for invalid or missing arguments.

methods.name: invalidType
methods.description: Throws an exception if an argument's type does not match expected types.

methods.name: throwRequired
methods.description: Throws an exception if required arguments are missing.
